messages:
olivia_marketing: T-minus 3 days to release — finalizing the announce post, benchmark narrative, and webinar CTA. Need engineering sign-off on changelog links + exact rollout timing so we can lock the publish window.

sam_engineering: Thanks — quick update: infra agreed to a 3-hr canary window, then ramp if no errors. Can start canary at 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z. Need final list of endpoints we'll hit during canary.

anika_docs: Docs PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — contains changelog, migration notes, and the new API examples. Please confirm we should merge before announce or feature-flag the new docs path.

kevin_product: Recommend merge docs before announce to reduce support spikes. If we can't, we should point announce to the staging docs with a note.

julian_sales: For inbound routing — we need the webinar reg form + lead tag. What's the global tag we use for this wave? Last time we used "announce-march-2026".

maria_marketing: Let's reuse "announce-march-2026" but add "benchmark-eval" for anyone who signs up from the benchmark blog. Sales can filter on the two tags.

sam_engineering: Canary endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/chat. We'll throttle to 10rps during canary, ramp to 50rps on success. If error rate > 2% for 10m, auto-rollback.

olivia_marketing: Perfect. Can we include a changelog excerpt in the announce? Short bullet list. Also want the docs link to be the canonical link in the tweet + post.

anika_docs: Suggested changelog excerpt (short):
```
- Improved KV cache warmup to cut median latency by 18%
- Added model pinning for deterministic rollouts
- New batching heuristics for multi-tenant workloads
```
You can use that as the bullets. Docs PR has canonical URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03.

sam_engineering: That excerpt looks good. One note: model pinning is currently behind config flag `enable_model_pinning`. We should be explicit in the docs that customers need to flip the flag or it won't be applied to existing deployments.

kevin_product: Add a one-liner to the announce: "Customers on Dedicated: contact CS for assisted rollouts."

olivia_marketing: Noted. Draft announce copy: "Today we're launching faster, cheaper inference: KV cache warmups, model pinning, and smarter batching — see changelog + docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03. Join our webinar Thurs 14:00 PT for demos." Thoughts?

julian_sales: For the webinar CTA please link to the HubSpot form: https://hub.redwood.ai/forms/announce-march-2026 — leads should be tagged with `announce-march-2026` + `benchmark-eval` if they come from the benchmark post.

maria_marketing: I'll wire the UTM parameters and the tags. Also will include a small bench graph in the blog (median latency vs tokens). Need the exported image by EOD tomorrow.

sam_engineering: Perf graphs coming from infra. I can export the median latency chart (per-model) and post it here by EOD.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy: canary start 2026-03-25T22:00:00Z; canary end 2026-03-26T01:00:00Z; full ramp 2026-03-26T02:00:00Z. Rollback threshold: 2% error rate or median latency increase > 25%.

olivia_marketing: OK — final checklist for engineering sign-off: 1) Confirm docs canonical URL (anika: done), 2) Confirm canary endpoints and throttle (sam: done), 3) Provide bench image (sam: pending), 4) Confirm rollback criteria (deploy-bot msg). If all green, we lock announce schedule for 2026-03-26 15:00 PT.

sam_engineering: All green aside from bench image. Will upload PNG to this thread by 2026-03-24 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:

anika_docs: Docs PR will be merged after final proofreading at 2026-03-24 20:00 PT. I'll add a note about the `enable_model_pinning` flag.

kevin_product: I'll notify CS about Dedicated assisted rollouts and prepare the canned response for support.

olivia_marketing: Great — locking schedule and prepping campaign assets. If anything slips, ping this thread with the tag @marketing-alert. Thanks everyone! :party_parrot:
